selection_rule: GSC-served BPC makers first, then by market coverage (NG-11 §2i)

selection_function.inputs: the four GSC BPC target books (row = maker × country, sheet = country code), snapshot-hashed below
selection_function.candidate: maker rows on sheets whose code is an SM-ECO-10060 member jurisdiction, with a syntactically valid maker domain (lowercase, LDH, no scheme/www/path)
selection_function.dedupe: maker key = ASCII-folded lowercase alphanumeric name; first valid domain wins; pairs are additionally unique on (object_id, jurisdiction) - when two makers share a domain, the first in rank order holds the pair
selection_function.rank: market coverage (count of distinct member jurisdictions the maker appears in) descending, then maker key ascending
selection_function.expand: each maker × each of its member jurisdictions in the canonical member order; take pairs in rank order until 1,000
selection_function.object_rule: object_id = host:<maker domain>; GSC's own GTIN objects are jurisdiction-door records, not bpc slots
